title: 第三十章  孙依诗的三位哥哥
content_zh:
陈木现在积攒的灵力一直都没有动用，就是为了银叶草成熟的时候能够一举练成丹药，这样的话距离他成为筑基期的时间就大大的缩短了，可以说有了银叶草炼制的丹药进入练气期大圆满很轻松，而之前的古武擒拿术也在日复一日的练习中得到了有效的锻炼。

    哈？为什么不知道陈木到底在什么时候练了古武？这每天都来找茬的小混混什么的不就是最好的陪练对象吗？而且还是那种都不用花钱的免费劳动力啊。

    “今天的课已经被错过了，我们还是回家吧。”苏林依和孙依诗今天只有一节课，结果就因为要去警察局做笔录，于是就这么唯一的一节课还是给翘掉了。

    “嗯。”陈木显然很喜欢这个提议，银叶草现在成熟了的话，正好是采摘的好时机，这几天就把丹药炼出来的话也算是解决了一桩心事。

    但是事情是不会这么顺利的，因为当陈木带着苏林依回到家里的时候，发现苏林依的别墅里面，苏本早就已经等在那里了。

    “听说小依你今天去了警察局？”苏本这话是说给苏林依的，但是眼睛却是在看着陈木，似乎是再责备陈木没有把自家女儿给保护好。

    “是啊，爸你用担心，就是昨天遇到了一些小混混，陈木已经解决了，今天只是去做笔录而已。”苏林依就知道苏本是没有事情不会来的，一来就一定是为了自己的安全之类的事情，果不其然今天说的就是刚刚去了警察局的事儿。

    “原来是这样。陈木觉得保镖这个活还做得来吗？”苏本又是一副慈祥的叔叔的样子看着陈木，之前有些不满的样子也被赞赏给取代了。

    苏本很满意陈木，自从陈木当上了苏林依的保镖之后，最近的事情苏本都有在观察者一举一动，有些突发事件并不是真正的突发事件，而是制造出来考验陈木的，而有些则是真正的就连苏本也没有料到的事情，不过通过这几天的观察，可以肯定的是，陈木完全能够胜任保镖这个职位，而且似乎做得很好。

    “苏叔叔，做保镖没什么问题。”陈木一板一眼的回答道，标准的答案，声音依旧没有任何起伏。

    但是苏本还是注意到了，陈木和之前在陈家的样子一点都不一样了，虽然有些疑惑，但并不知道为什么，只能暗暗地留心观察了。

    所有的人都觉得陈木不对劲，陈木变了，但是只有陈木自己知道，其实自己还是之前的自己，就是换了个壳子，换而言之之前的陈木早就已经死了。

    “既然你这么说，我也就放心了，现在你就正式的成为小依的保镖报表了。”苏本看着陈木现在这个样子，心中还是挺高兴的，毕竟现在的他和之前想必已经优秀了太多太多。

    “谢谢苏叔叔。”陈木依旧是装作一副小辈的样子，但心里面却不以为然：老子已经活了不知道几百年，叫你是叔叔还很抬举你，只是不知道你要是知道真相会不会受不了。

    苏本依旧是笑意十足的说道：“既然这样，今天晚上就一起出去吃吧，把小诗那孩子也叫上。”苏本和孙依诗家里面本就是交好，苏本对于小诗就像是当做自己的另一个女儿一样，有什么好事儿都不会忘了孙依诗。
content_en:
Chen Mu has not used the spiritual power he has accumulated so far, just so that he can refine the elixir in one fell swoop when the silver leaf grass matures. In this way, the time until he reaches the foundation building stage will be greatly shortened. It can be said that with the elixir refined from silver leaf grass, it is easy to enter the Qi training stage, and the previous ancient martial arts grappling skills have also been effectively trained in day after day practice.

    ha? Why don't you know when Chen Mu practiced ancient martial arts? Isn't this little gangster who is looking for trouble every day the best partner for sparring? And it’s the kind of free labor that doesn’t cost anything.

    "Today's class has been missed, let's go home." Su Linyi and Sun Yishi only had one class today, but they missed the only class because they had to go to the police station to take notes.

    "Yes." Chen Mu obviously liked this proposal very much. If the silver-leaf grass is mature now, it would be a good time to pick it. If the elixir is refined in the past few days, it can be regarded as solving a worry.

    But things would not go so smoothly, because when Chen Mu brought Su Linyi back home, he found that Su Ben was already waiting there in Su Linyi's villa.

    "I heard that Xiaoyi, you went to the police station today?" Su Ben said this to Su Linyi, but his eyes were looking at Chen Mu, as if he was blaming Chen Mu again for not protecting his daughter.

    "Yes, dad, don't worry. We just met some gangsters yesterday. Chen Mu has already dealt with them. Today we are just going to take notes." Su Linyi knew that Su Ben would not come if he had nothing to do. He must have come for his own safety. As expected, what he was talking about today was what he had just gone to the police station.

    "So that's it. Do you think Chen Mu can still do the job of a bodyguard?" Su Ben looked at Chen Mu like a kind uncle again, and his previous dissatisfaction was replaced by appreciation.

    Su Ben was very satisfied with Chen Mu. Ever since Chen Mu became Su Linyi's bodyguard, Su Ben had been observing every move of recent events. Some emergencies were not real emergencies, but were created to test Chen Mu, and some were real things that even Su Ben had not expected. However, after observing these days, it is certain that Chen Mu is fully qualified for the position of bodyguard, and he seems to be doing a good job.

    "Uncle Su, there's nothing wrong with being a bodyguard." Chen Mu replied flatly, with a standard answer and his voice remained calm.

    But Su Ben still noticed that Chen Mu looked completely different from how he looked at the Chen family before. Although he was a little confused, he didn't know why, so he could only observe it secretly.

    Everyone felt that something was wrong with Chen Mu, that Chen Mu had changed, but only Chen Mu knew that he was actually still the same person as before, but had changed his shell. In other words, the previous Chen Mu was already dead.

    "Since you said that, I'm relieved. Now you will officially become Xiaoyi's bodyguard report." Su Ben was quite happy when he saw Chen Mu like this. After all, he must be much better than before.

    "Thank you, Uncle Su." Chen Mu still pretended to be a junior, but he didn't agree in his heart: I have lived for hundreds of years, and I still praise you very much when I call you uncle, but I don't know if you wouldn't be able to bear it if you knew the truth.

    Su Ben still said with a smile: "In that case, let's go out to eat together tonight, and invite Xiao Shi's kid too." Su Ben and Sun Yi Shi had always been good friends at home, and Su Ben treated Xiao Shi as if he were another daughter of his, and would never forget Sun Yi Shi if anything good happened.
